name: ZeroEval
intro: ZeroEval 是 DeepSeek 报告引用的统一语言模型评测框架，用于组织多任务语言模型评估。
intro_en: ZeroEval is a unified language-model evaluation framework referenced by DeepSeek reports for organizing multi-task language model assessments.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with No independent ZeroEval benchmark paper was found. Primary source is the official WildEval/ZeroEval repository pinned at commit 8c1485edf12c6efb5f69135a562927c5ad484059: README.md; CITATION.cff; zero_eval_local.sh; zero_eval_api.sh; src/unified_infer.py; src/unified_utils.py; src/task_configs.py; src/_TEMPLATES.py; src/templates/{MCQA,OEQA,ZEBRA_GRID}.py; src/merge_results.py; and src/evaluation/{eval_utils,mcqa_eval,math_eval,crux_eval,zebra_grid_eval,summarize}.py. CITATION.cff dates the software release to 2024-07-18. DeepSeek-V3 arXiv:2412.19437 Appendix/Table 19 is supporting evidence only: it borrows the Zero-Eval prompt format for MMLU-Redux rather than defining ZeroEval or running this repository end to end.. ZeroEval is an evaluation framework, not a fixed dataset. At official repository commit 8c1485edf12c6efb5f69135a562927c5ad484059, zero_eval_local.sh and zero_eval_api.sh route repository task/model configuration through unified inference, task templates, sharding, cache/resume, output merging, and task-specific evaluators. Local vLLM/Hugging Face backends generate directly, while only configured API-provider calls use the bounded retry handler (retry_limit=10). Distinct scorers handle MMLU-Redux, GSM8K/MATH, CRUX, ZebraLogic, and G-PlanET. Expected result counts are completeness gates, not a construction total; no paper-side annotator or QC pipeline exists to draw.
